messages:
Sam: quick sync  paid search + retarget micro-burst for product-launch week. want crisp rules: search pacing, creative refresh cadence, retarget ttl, and lead routing.

Nora: proposal: reduce CPC for broad/non-branded by 12% weekdays, 18% over long weekends. keep branded bids unchanged.

Ethan: agree but add a hard floor so we don't drop below 0.65 * current bid or $0.40 whichever is higher. last quarterly dip cost us impression share.

Sam: noted. rule: bid = max(0.65 * current_bid, 0.40). also add daily max decrease = 20% to avoid sudden swings.

growth-bot: Campaign "Launch Burst - Search+Retarget" created (id: 82077). daily_budget: $5,500.

Nora: creative plan: rotate 3 variants every 48h. primary CTA = "See live demo" for high-intent retargeters; secondary = "Download brief" for cold traffic. promote variant with +12% CTR after 24h if statistically significant.

Ethan: retarget audience TTL = 14d. exclude crm_status:converted within 14d and event:demo_reg within 30d. also set frequency cap = 3/day.

Devon: landing page UTMs and tracking snippet (paste):
```
utm_source=paid_search&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=pl_launch26&utm_content={{creative_id}}
```
and fire pixel on demo_reg and download events.

Sam: monitoring: enable 10-min cadence alerts for CPA > +15% and CVR drop > 25% vs 1d median. dashboard: https://go.redwood/launch-burst-dash

Nora: small note  for creative A/B we should rotate the hero copy test in display vs search differently (search gets benefit-driven copy, display gets awareness copy).

Ethan: I'll update the bidding script and run a dry-run at 11:00 PT. Devon, can you make sure lead webhook (POST /webhooks/marketing/launch) accepts referral.utms as array?

Devon: yes, webhook accepts utm array. sample payload I tested: {"lead_id":"L-9082","email":"alex@corp.com","utm":["paid_search","pl_launch26"],"source":"paid"} returns 200.

Sam: great. action items:
- Ethan: implement bid floor & max-decrease, dry-run at 11:00 PT
- Devon: confirm pixel fires for demo_reg + ensure webhook parses utm array (done in staging)
- Nora: upload 3 creative variants + copy rules to creative library
- Sam: publish pacing rules and enable alerts

growth-bot: Dry-run scheduled for campaign 82077 at 2026-12-18T19:00:00Z (simulation).

Sam: thanks team  we'll reconvene after dry-run to decide whether to scale the burst to $7k/day for the final two days. :rocket:
